name: Run cost badge shows the seeded run's cost on the PR list, timeline, and trace drawer
description: L01 Run Cost Badge. The seed links one completed, priced agent run (8,190→929 tokens, $0.0013) to PR #482's review, so every cost surface has data without a model call. Asserts the COST column on the PR list ($0.0013), the full badge on the Agent runs timeline and review-run header ('9,119 tok · $0.0013'), and the COST stat inside the run trace drawer. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
